Commentary.Commentary: However, weather forecast is a bit dodgy and if the tourists show some spunk, you never know. The chase is just around the corner, so don't go anywhere.
The lead is a whopping 564 for the hosts and with approximately 5-and-a-half sessions left in the match, it'll be a tough task ahead for Pakistan to save this game.
A brisk onslaught today morning by Cook and Root, adding 75 more runs in just 9 overs before the hosts decided to declare.
FOUR! DRILLED! Tossed up outside off, Cook leans into it and drills it through the covers as the ball races away to the fence for a boundary. That's it then as ENGLAND HAVE FINALLY DECLARED.
Full toss on middle and off, Root slog sweeps it high to deep square leg but just short of a diving Hafeez. Single taken.
100-run stand between Cook and Root.
FOUR! WOW, GENIUS STUFF! This lad has a big bag of tricks, doesn't he? This is the switch hit to a ball pitched outside leg and he absolutely whacks it towards the cover fence for a boundary.
Floats it up on off, Cook goes for the slog sweep but gets a top edge that goes high but falls safe at backward point. Single taken.
Full toss outside leg, worked away to deep square leg for a single.
Fuller on middle and off, worked away to the leg side for a single.
Floats it up outside off, driven down to long on for a single.
Sliding on middle and leg, worked away to the leg side for a single.

FOUR! BLASTED AWAY! No stopping Root at all! Floats it up outside off, Root goes across to that one and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket to find the fence. When he is in this kind of mood, nothing much a bowler can do especially if his team is waiting for the opposition to declare. Lead is now 550.
Loopy outside leg, Root gets across and laps it down very fine down the leg side past the keeper to the deep for another brace.
Drifting in around off, swept away to deep square leg for a single.
Floats it up outside off, Cook pushes at it but is struck on the pads. Impact well outside the line.
Floats it up around leg stump, Cook goes across and sweeps it down to fine leg for a single.
Floats it up on leg stump, works it away towards mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! ROOT IS ON THE RAMPAGE NOW! Flatter on a length outside leg, Root pulls out another trick by playing the reverse sweep through backward point to find the fence. Declaration batting is surely on.
Drifting in around leg stump, Root gets across to that one and plays a lap sweep down to fine leg for a brace.
Tossed up on middle and off, Cook steps out and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted on off, clipped towards mid-wicket.
AZHAR ALI comes on to bowl.
Fuller on middle and off, Cook gets across and clips it with the turn to the leg side for a single.
Fuller on off, Cook works it towards mid-wicket.
Flighted around off, Cook misses the reverse sweep and is hit on the pads.
Fuller on middle and leg, clipped away on the leg side for a single.
21st Test fifty for JOE ROOT.
FOUR! SUPER SHOT! Low full toss on middle and off, Root goes across to sweep it cleanly mid-wicket as the ball races to the fence for a boundary.
Flatter on off, swept towards the leg side for a single.
Fuller on off, Root pushes at that one and gets a thick inside edge to mid-wicket.
FOUR! POWERED AWAY! Another short ball on off, Root goes back to that one and pulls it away hard to the deep square leg fence for a boundary.

FOUR! HAMMERED! Short ball on middle and leg, Root goes for the pull but gets it high on the bat. Doesn't matter though as the ball has enough elevation to clear the short square leg fence for a boundary.
Fuller on off, driven off the front foot towards mid on.

FOUR! POOR STUFF! Good length drifting on to the pads, Root gets across to that one and clips it down to fine leg where Amir stops it with one foot only for his other foot to come in the way and kick it past the ropes. Easy runs for England.
Good length around off, Root gets back and jabs it towards point for a brace.
Loopy leg break on middle and off, spins back in to rap Cook on the pads as he misses the back foot push. Appeal for lbw but probably did too much.
Darted in on leg stump, Cook works it with soft hands to mid-wicket.
Slider outside off, Cook gets back to that one and punches it through the covers for a brace.
Flatter outside off, Cook goes back to cut and gets an inside edge that goes down to short fine leg.
Drops it short outside off, punched off the back foot through through the covers for a single.
Floats it up on middle and leg, blocked off the front foot solidly.
YASIR SHAH comes on for the first time today.
FOUR! STREAKY! Back of a length outside off, Cook flashes hard at that one but gets a thick slice through the vacant slip cordon to the third man fence for a boundary.
Short of a length outside off, Cook goes back to slash it away but is beaten.
Length ball outside off, cut away down to third man for a single.
Good length down the leg side, Root misses the flick.
Full and wide outside off, driven sweetly through backward point for a brace.
Fuller outside off, driven off the front foot towards mid off.
Short of a length outside off, crunched off the back foot to sweeper cover for a brace.
Back of a length outside off, Root gets back to that one and cuts it through backward point for a single.
Length ball outside off, Cook gets back and taps it towards point for a quick single. Lead is now just 500 folks! Cook probably thinks he needs many more runs!
Good length outside off, Root glides it towards point for a quick single.
Back of a length outside off, Cook glides it down to third man for a single.
Shortish on middle and leg, Root goes back to pull but mistimes it towards mid-wicket for a single.
MOHAMMAD AMIR to bowl from the other end.
Good length outside off, jabbed off the back foot to point for a single.
Back of a length outside off, cut away off the back foot towards third man for a single. The ball went off the slice.
50th Test half century for ALASTAIR COOK. He does it in 55 balls, his fastest Test fifty yet!
FOUR! SHOT! Fuller outside off, Cook driven through the covers for a boundary. That's been timed really well. Brings up yet another milestone for the England skipper.
Good length angled in from around off, pushed off the back foot towards mid on.
Back of a length on middle and leg, worked off the back foot to mid-wicket for a single.
Good length outside off, pushed off the back foot towards point.
The players and umpires are out there in the middle.

Hello and a warm welcome to Day 4 of the 2nd Test between England and Pakistan. England are in a very good place right now. Instead of enforcing a follow-on, they have chosen to extend their 489-run lead, and are likely to declare early. Pakistan face a tough task ahead and ensure their bowlers stay on track. Can they take this opportunity to redeem themselves? Stay tuned for the live commentary.
.....DAY 4, SESSION 1.....

Join us tomorrow for the final stages of this exciting Test match at Old Trafford, Manchester. Will Pakistan manage to redeem themselves or will England win it on Day 4 itself? That is if the weather allows as the forecast isn't that promising. Join us tomorrow at 1530 IST and find out! Until then, take care!

Pakistan were not able to match the pacy attack and their only answer came in the form of a dogged Misbah-ul-Haq, who determinedly put up a half century. Masood acquitted himself well too, and Wahab made a brief yet impressive appearance at the end of their innings. Their cause wasn't helped by the gloomy weather and frequent rain stoppages throughout the day.

This was another day for the hosts from the first delivery bowled. The English bowlers showed great discipline in their lines and lengths, tempting the batsmen repeatedly. Chris Woakes led the pack with his 4-fer and each of the other bowlers picked up at least one scalp apiece.

It was a perplexing decision by Alastair Cook to decide to bat a second time instead of enforcing a follow-on. Possibly to give the bowlers a rest, or maybe to strengthen their gigantic lead further. In any case, the English will look to put up a tidy total and declare sometime early tomorrow, placing the huge burden of chasing it down on Pakistan.

Cook and Root do well to end Day 3 unscathed. England have put up a hurried 98 runs to end the day with a colossal lead of 489 and can rest easy knowing that the target might well be outside Pakistan's grasp. Mohammad Amir was the only one who posed a threat. The rest of Pakistan's bowlers proved to be listless and ineffective.
Last ball of the day! Full ball on off, Root strides ahead and plays it through covers for a single. England have managed to score on each and every ball of this over. THAT'S STUMPS ON DAY 3!
FOUR! What execution! Tossed up ball on middle, Root kneels and takes it on the full to deposit it through square leg for a well struck boundary.
Tad full on middle, Cook flicked that to the leg side for a single.
Another quick run. Serves it a bit quick on off, Root pushes it to covers and they cross for a run.
Flighted ball on middle and leg, Cook sets ahead and plays it through mid on for a run.
Tossed up ball on the pads, Root plays it through mid-wicket. Three runs taken.
Last over of the day.
Outside off, Root pushes it to covers for a single.
Hurls a full ball, outside off, Root sets across and confidently plays it to covers.
Fuller ball on off, pushed to point.
Tad short on middle, Root shimmies and pulls it. The ball falls just short of Rahat at Mid on. He fumbles and a brace is taken.
Amir serves a length ball on off, Cook gets back and tamely pushes it to backward point for a single.
Full ball on off, Cook comes ahead and plays it to mid off.
Flighted ball on off, Root taps it to the off side. End of an over.
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball but fails.
FOUR! Loopy ball on off, Root kneels and plays a brilliant slog sweep over the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Short ball on off, Root looks to heave that but misses.
On the leg stump line, Cook nudges it through deep mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball outside off, Cook sets back and plays it into the ground.
Tad fuller on off, steered to third man for a single.
Serves a full ball, outside off. It moved a bit but Root who had moved to the off side, steered it through backward point for a single.
Length ball, outside off, a play and a miss.
Back of a length ball on middle, Root off his back foot tries to glance it. It beats him and is hit him on the thigh pad.
Tad full on off, Cook stands tall and plays it through covers for a single. Alastair has taken lot of quick runs today.
Length ball, angling away. Root taps it through point for a single.
Hurls it on the pads, Root nudges it through square leg for a single.
Tad short outside off, jammed to point.
Serves it fuller on off, pushed through covers for a single.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Loopy ball, it came back in after pitching. Alastair defends that awkwardly.
Tossed up ball on off, Cook plays a forward defense towards the leg side.
FOUR! Full ball outside off, Root steers that through slip cordon for a welcome boundary straightaway.
JOE ROOT will bat next.

OUT! Hales walks after that nick! Perfect length ball on off and middle, it nipped back in. Hales was cramped for room and was in no frame to play that. As a result the ball goes off the inside edge of the bat. The keeper takes a good catch to get the first wicket. Amir has taken Hales twice in this match.
Tad fuller ball on off, it had a movement coming in. Hales plays it back to the bowler.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tad short, angling away. Hales sees that wide ball and punches it hard towards backward point. A good stop there by the fielder.
Cook steers that fine through covers for a single. Full on off, width too offered.
Loopy ball on off, Hales looks to scoop that but it beats him. The ball balloons off his pads towards the first slip.
Tad short and Cook steers that through covers for a single.
Another full ball on off, Hales gets it wider off the covers for a single.
Serves it full on off, pushed to covers.
The batsman has driven that ball straight back. One run added to the total.
Flighted ball outside off, it turned back in. Cook in his defense gets beaten and the ball goes off his pads towards the off side.
Perfect length ball on the pads, the English skipper strides ahead and plays it to square leg for a single.
The batsman drives this through the covers.
Full ball on off, Cook looks to drive but it goes off a leading edge towards mid off.
Full ball on off, angled in, Cook on his front foot tries to drive it but it gets to his pads off an inside edge. No harm done.
Perfect length ball outside off, Cook sets ahead and pushes it through covers.
Cook pushes it towards mid on. Full on off, Alastair gets forwards and drives it down the ground for a brace.
Serves it on of, Hales leaves it for the keeper.
Tossed up ball on the pads, flicked to the leg side for a single.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
FOUR! Tossed up ball on th pads, Cook strightaway sweeps it through square leg for a boundary.
Welcome back. Yasir will continue his over. Cook on strike.
We have a latest update of play getting resumed in a bit. To the surprise it is bright sunshine breaking at Old Trafford. Let's play.
It is drizzling once again. The players and umpires have walked off the ground. Only good news is that England lead by 447. Meanwhile, the hover cover is in place. Stay tuned for latest update.
Short ball on off, Hales drive it through covers for a single.
Short ball on off, played to the off side.
Full on off, played to mid on. End of an over.

Edged and safe! Length ball outside off, it angles in after pitching. Cook in his approach pushes at it casually and the ball goes off the edge to the first slip. For the record falls just short of Hafeez who was standing too far maybe. Cook is all smiles.
Length ball on off, Cook steers that through third man for a brace.
FOUR! That was a textbook cover drive! Tad full, width on offer, Cook without any trouble drives it through the gap of cover fielder. Boundary is achieved in no time.
Serves it fuller on off, it angles in after pitching. Cook strides and plays it to mid off.
Length ball on middle, Hales chips that through square leg for a single.
Poor fielding! Serves it outside off, Hales cuts it and the fielder at point misfields. Single is taken.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Yasir and another short ball. Cook hammers it through mid-wicket and single is taken.
Tad short on middle, Cook flicks it to mid-wicket.
Serves it full on off, Hales cramps back and plays it to the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Short and punished! Tad short on off, Hales gets back and punches it down the ground for a boundary.
YASIR SHAH to bowl now.
FOUR! Hammered! Short ball on middle, Cook sets his eye in time and rides the bounce to pull it well. The ball goes through mid-wicket and it is a boundary. The lead is 432 now!
Tad fuller outside off, Hales sets back and punches it through covers. Three runs taken.
Full ball on off, pushed to covers.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Leg bye. Fuller on the pads, Cook hops and tries to nudge that but misses. The ball goes to the off side and they cross for a run. There was an half hearted appeal for LBW. It was turned down. Misbah after discussing with his bowler looks to review it but decides against it.

FOUR! That was a close shave! Tad full, width on offer. Cook without any foot work looks to cut that but it goes off the inside half of the bat just over the stumps. The ball is actually raced away to the fence down long leg.
Tad full, moving away. Alex lunges and blocks it to covers.
Good length ball, angling away, Hales negotiated that by leaving it.
Perfect length ball on off, better than the last ball. Alex sets ahead and defends it to covers.
That was a super bouncer! Short and wide, it goes too high and Hales can only see it going to the keeper.
Hurls a length ball on middle and off, Hales defends it back to the bowler.
Full ball on off, it angled in. Cook sets back and cuts it through covers for three runs.
Bouncer! Short ball on middle and leg, Hales ducks under it and lets it through.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Length ball, moving away from the batsman. It is being cut to point.
Serves it fuller outside off, pushed to covers.
Nice full ball on off, defended neatly.

FOUR! Half chance put down! Length ball, outside off, Hales lashes on to it but gets a thick outside edge. The ball flies just over Hafeez at first slip. It should have been taken, maybe the fielder was bending too low and was late in his reaction. Nevertheless, a boundary is achieved through that region.
Serves a full ball, outside off. No real movement there, Hales lets it through for the keeper.
Full on off, tapped to point for a single.
Peach! Good length ball on off, it moved a bit. Hales timed his leave to perfection as it went just whizzes of the off stump.
FOUR! Hales has punched that off his back foot! Tad full outside off, Hales gets back and punches it through backward point for a well placed boundary.
Length ball outside off, the same ploy of bowling wide and outside off prevails. Hales is aware and lets it through.
Short ball and on middle, Cook hops and defends it to the off side. There is some hesitation but at the end a run is completed. Cook is running for everything possible here.
Neatly played to fine leg for a single! Fuller ball on the pads, Cook obliges.
Tad short and it is serves on the legs, Hales pushes it tamely to mid-wicket for a single.
Hales pushes that full ball to mid on.
Tad fuller, width on offer too, Cook from his crease drives it to backward point fielder for a single.
Back of a length ball outside off, Cook plays it away from his body and jams it to covers.
That came in! Rahat comes steaming in and the ball nips back in, Cook gets cramped back and gets hit on his thigh pad. The Pakistan side is surely liking the current conditions to bowl.
A full ball on middle and off, Hales gets well over the top of the ball and defends it back to the bowler.
Length ball in the area of uncertainty. Hales get ahead and leaves it for the keeper.
Fuller ball on the pads, Hales flicks it to mid-wicket.
Serves a perfect length ball outside off, Hales off his back foot looks to drive it through covers but it goes to the off side where the fielder makes a good stop.
Tad full outside off, going away from the batsman, Hales lets it through to the keeper.
Full ball on off, defended well of the front foot.
Leg bye. Fuller ball on the pads, Hales tries to play that to the on side but misses the shot. The ball goes off the pads. Single is taken.
That ball has taken the inside edge onto the pads.

Back of a length on the pads, Hales misses the flick shot and the ball goes to the off side. Cook is already half way to take that single but is sent back. The throw is fired at the non-striker's end. Cook is well in.
Length ball outside off, Cook plays it to the off side with soft hands for a single.
We are back once again after an interruption. Cook to take the strike and Rahat to bowl at him.
1740 local time, 2210 IST update, we have a game on the cards and hope there is no more rain.

Oh dear, it has started to rain once again. The hide and seek game still prevails. In a matter of 4 balls, the hover cover is brought on as it is drizzling. Meanwhile, the fielders and the English openers go back to the pavilion. Stay tuned for the latest update.
That was a peach of a delivery! Length ball outside off, it got high after the bounce. Cook tries to play at it but misses.
Length ball on off, defended well off his front foot.
RAHAT ALI will bowl from the other end.
Amir serves it outside off, it angled away yet again. Hales sees it and lets it through.
Length ball, angling away from Hales, it was left alone.
We are back. ALASTAIR COOK AND ALEX HALES will continue to bat. MOHAMMAD AMIR will bowl at them.
Hey, folks! We have a good news, finally we will see some cricketing action. The game was halted for a quite some time after that resistant pouring. It is resuming at 1655 local time, 2125 IST.
Nothing much to report. Tea is over but the rain break isn't. The covers are on. Stay tuned for updates.
The umpires have taken advantage of this break due to the rain and called for TEA EARLY.
The rain is back and the umpire calls the players off the field as hover cover is brought back on.
Bouncer on middle, 85.8 mph, Hales ducks again.
Bouncer! Hales ducks to evade it.
Length ball outside off, cut through point.
Length ball and a smidgen outside off, Hales shoulders his arms.
Good length delivery on middle and off, flicked to deep backward square leg for a single.
Back of a length ball around off, blocked off the back foot back to the bowler.
Length ball on middle and off, worked to the leg side.
Length ball outside off, defended to point for a single.
FOUR! Outside off, Cook punishes that shorter delivery by cutting it through the covers and all the way to the fence.
Full on middle, flicked to backward square leg for a single.
Rahat Ali to bowl from the other end.
Good length delivery wide outside off, left alone.
Length ball and a tad outside off, Cook lets it through.
Short ball outside off, Cook looks to push it to the off side and the ball goes to the third slip.
FOUR! Short ball outside off, Cook cuts it crisply through point and the ball screams it's way to the ropes.
Shorter ball outside off, left alone.
Length ball outside off, defended to point.
